title: procurement-tools datasheet record
description: What the manufacturer's own documentation says about one part number, with the document it came from. Written by the spec-sheet-retrieval skill to data/datasheets/<manufacturer>-<part-number>.json. The point of the record is provenance: a spec value with no document behind it is an unknown, not a value.

part_number.description: Exactly as the manufacturer writes it, including spacing and suffixes. 'GLM 165-27C' and 'GLM165-27C' are recorded as written and reconciled in aliases.

aliases.description: Other spellings of the same part number seen in the wild: retailer SKUs, spacing variants, EAN/UPC, distributor order codes.

region.description: Region this part number is sold in. Regional siblings get their own record; see the equivalence record for the link.

egress.description: Country the fetch left from. Manufacturer sites serve different documents per region; a spec sheet fetched from the wrong country is a different document that looks like the right one.

documents.description: The documents the specs were read from. An empty list means the skill found nothing and the record should say so rather than being filled from a retailer.

doc_revision.description: The document's own revision or print code, e.g. '1 609 92A 8XZ (2024.03)'. Not the retrieval date.

local_path.description: Where the PDF was saved in the repo, when it was saved.

sha256.description: Of the saved file. Manufacturers replace documents at the same URL without changing the filename.

accessed_via.description: Which route got it: WebFetch, geo-egress il/us, playwright, claude-in-chrome, distributor mirror.

specs.description: One entry per published value. Values are copied, not paraphrased, and units are kept as printed.

condition.description: The qualifier the headline number hides: accuracy 'under favourable conditions', range 'with target plate', runtime 'at 20 degC'.

document.description: Which of documents[] this came from — title or url.

req.description: Requirement this value answers, when the retrieval was driven by a spec.

not_published.description: Parameters that were looked for and are genuinely absent from the manufacturer's documentation. Recording the absence stops the next agent repeating the search, and an absence across a whole field is itself a finding.

contradictions.description: Where the manufacturer's own documents disagree with each other, or where a widely-repeated retail figure differs from the datasheet. Both values are kept.
